narrative.overview: The Cordex mark replaces the O in CORDEX with an orbit around a soft glowing core. That's the system: one calm point of focus (the blue accent), everything else in disciplined near-black orbit around it. The interface is a precision instrument for gym operators managing churn risk, follow-ups, and revenue — not a control room. It earns trust through restraint, not through blinking lights. This explicitly rejects generic SaaS scaffolding and the unused 'command center' neon layer still sitting as dead config in tailwind.config.js.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black navy depth (four flat layers, no pure black)
One accent color (orbit-blue) carrying focus, interactivity, and brand identity
Status colors reserved strictly for state, never decoration
Condensed display type for headings, tabular monospace for every metric/KPI number
Motion is a confirmation, not a performance

rules.name: The One Nucleus Rule
rules.body: orbit-blue is the only color allowed to carry brand identity. Status colors report state; they never substitute as a second brand accent.

rules.name: The Retired Neon Rule
rules.body: command-* and pi-* colors/glows in tailwind.config.js are legacy and not part of this system. Do not reach for them in new work.

rules.name: The Tabular Truth Rule
rules.body: Any number a user might compare across rows or over time uses .num (JetBrains Mono, tabular-nums).

rules.name: The One Glow Rule
rules.body: Only orbit-blue gets a glow, and only on the single most elevated surface on screen — never on a resting card, never in more than one color at once, never animated into a pulse.

dos: Do treat orbit-blue (#3B82F6) as the only brand accent; everything else is neutral or status.
Do use the four-step neutral depth scale to convey hierarchy instead of stacking shadows.
Do render every KPI/metric number in .num (JetBrains Mono, tabular-nums).
Do reserve glow effects for the single most-elevated element on screen, in blue only.
Do keep motion short and purposeful (150-450ms), always with a prefers-reduced-motion fallback.
Do show AI-origin content in ai-violet so users can always tell what the model suggested.
donts: Don't introduce the command-* Tailwind color group in new components — it's legacy, unused config.
Don't use pi-* glow/pulse utilities — alarm-style pulsing contradicts the calm-precision direction.
Don't use gray text on a colored background — bump toward ink when contrast is close.
Don't nest cards inside cards, or default to a card when a plain list/row would read better.
Don't use border-left/border-right colored stripes as a callout accent.
Don't let a screen ship with only a dashboard and no actionable task.
